repository.name: slopstack
repository.note: This is the TEMPLATE baseline, not an application baseline. Any derived app inherits these invariants; see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
repository.remote_note: No git remote is configured. Nothing pushes anywhere.

tool_versions.pnpm_discrepancy: package.json declares packageManager pnpm@11.8.0 but the audit machine had pnpm 12.8.1 on PATH. No corepack, no .npmrc, so nothing enforced the declaration. CI now pins 11.8.0 to match package.json.
tool_versions.node_modules_state: recorded by reading apps/web/node_modules/<pkg>/package.json, i.e. the resolved install, not the declared range

module_identity.note: This IS the template, so its identity is the correct final identity. Derived apps rename it in phase 1; that rename must not touch the data directory or any collection ID.

SLOPSTACK_SECURE_COOKIES.consumed_by: parsed into Config, read by nothing

SLOPSTACK_REGISTRATION_ENABLED.consumed_by: RegistrationAllowed in internal/app/auth.go; no route calls it

SLOPSTACK_LOG_LEVEL.consumed_by: parsed into Config, read by nothing

SLOPSTACK_DEVELOPMENT.consumed_by: pocketbase.Config.DefaultDev (main.go:20); also set to true by .air.toml

env.bool_parsing_note: envBool uses os.LookupEnv, so an empty-but-set variable parses as false rather than falling back. env treats an empty string as unset. The two helpers disagree on that edge case.

frontend_only.VITE_API_URL: read by apps/web/src/api/pocketbase.ts; not part of the Go config surface

routes.note: only product caller is a window.open('/docs') link in apps/web/src/app.tsx:811

routes.behavior: returns a hard-coded empty JSON array and ignores its Config argument (_ = config)
routes.note: documented separately by huma.Register in registerTodoAPI (app.go:68) and implemented separately by e.Router.GET in registerTodoRoutes (app.go:72). Nothing links the two.

openapi.title: Slopstack API
openapi.adapter: humago.New(http.NewServeMux(), ...) in main.go; the mux is never served
openapi.purpose: schema and documentation only; Huma owns no live route
openapi.known_inconsistency: The Huma spec for /api/todos and the actual handler are registered separately, so the OpenAPI schema can drift from runtime behaviour. A huma.Register without a matching e.Router documents a 404 endpoint; an e.Router without a matching huma.Register is invisible to generate:api and generate:client. Phase 2 work item, recorded not fixed.

migrations.rule: Preserve applied migrations; add new migration files for schema changes.

storage.note: Relative default, so CWD-dependent by construction.
storage.must_not_break: Renaming or moving this directory silently starts the server against an empty database.

pnpm_build.note: pnpm build (tsc -b && vite build) was not executed during this audit. CI runs it.

pre_fix_baseline.note: Reproduced during this audit by restoring the pre-fix schema.go and schema_test.go on a clean tree and re-running the commands.

go_test.cause: EnsureCollections marshalled field descriptions and unmarshalled them back into a *core.Collection; under encoding/json/v2 on go1.27 that recursion never terminates.
go_test.fixed_by: 0b6ea41 fix(server): build typed core fields instead of JSON round-trip

pnpm_test.note: passed only because apps/web runs vitest run --passWithNoTests and no test file existed. The green was empty.

ci.go_working_directory_note: Single Go module rooted at go.mod with no nested go.mod, so root-level ./... covers all Go code. Kept at the root deliberately: if Go code is ever added outside apps/server, root ./... picks it up automatically. Now set explicitly rather than implicit.
baseline_check_covers: route table: docs/baseline.json routes vs e.Router.<METHOD>("<path>" in apps/server/internal/app, both directions
toolchain: pins in .github/workflows/ci.yml vs tool_versions recorded here
ci.unverifiable_in_ci: pnpm generate:client writes a gitignored directory, so the git diff --exit-code step after it cannot detect a missing or stale generated client.
ci.golangci_note: .golangci.yml exists at the repo root but is not run in CI.

compatibility_invariants.note: Must not break without an explicit documented decision and a migration note. Prose in docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
data: PocketBase data directory SLOPSTACK_STORAGE_PATH, default pb_data, holding data.db, auxiliary.db, storage/, .notify/
Collection names: users, groups, permissions, group_permissions, user_permissions, group_members, todos, audit_logs; users must stay an auth collection
Collection IDs in _collections.id, including _pb_users_auth_ for users and pbc_* for the rest
Existing user credentials and auth records: _superusers, users passwords, tokenKey, OAuth/OTP/MFA rows
http: The /api/* request and response shapes, field names, types and status codes
The 'slopstack openapi export' CLI command and its openapi/openapi.json output path
compatibility_invariants.phase_1_module_rename_caveat: Renaming the Go module, the web package name and the SLOPSTACK_ env prefix is a code-only change. It must NOT rename the PocketBase database, move pb_data, change any collection ID or name, or change any env var default.

provenance.generator: phase 0 baseline audit, hand-authored and verified against the working tree
provenance.tool_versions_source: live toolchain (go version, node -v, pnpm -v) plus apps/web/node_modules/<pkg>/package.json for resolved JS versions
provenance.test_results_source: actually executed during the phase 0 audit on this commit, including a deliberate reproduction of the pre-fix stack overflow by restoring schema.go from 0b6ea41^ and restoring the tree afterwards
provenance.routes_source: grep of e.Router.* in apps/server/internal/app/app.go, and the single huma.Register call in the same file
provenance.collections_source: apps/server/internal/app/schema.go coreCollections, cross-checked against a read-only SQLite query (sqlite3 'file:data.db?mode=ro&immutable=1') against apps/server/pb_data/data.db _collections
provenance.collection_ids_source: read from the local pb_data; PocketBase mints them at creation so they are NOT reproducible from source and differ per data directory
provenance.collection_rules_source: not verified. The table records what the code declares, which is that no template collection sets any API rule. The live database's rule values were not queried.
provenance.how_to_regenerate: Update this file in the same commit as any deliberate change to routes, collections, env vars or the toolchain, then run 'python3 scripts/check-baseline.py' locally and confirm it exits 0 before pushing. The script fails CI on route-table or toolchain drift; it does not check collections, env vars or test counts.
